scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Individual Entrepreneur, Self Help Group (SHG), Farmers Producer Organization (FPO), Farmers Cooperative (FCO), Joint Liability Group (JLG) or Section 8 Company
Must set up a breeder farm with at least 100 sows and 25 boars
Breeding animals must be sourced from Central/State Government farms, universities or local farmers with high genetic merit
Remaining project funds must be arranged through a bank loan, financial institution loan or self‑financing
Applicant must have received training or have technical experts or sufficient experience in the relevant field
A sanction loan and a bank guarantee from a scheduled bank, together with project appraisal by that bank, are required
Applicant must own or lease land where the project will be established
All relevant KYC documents must be available
Subsidy cannot be claimed for land purchase, rent, lease, working capital or personal vehicles
In self‑financing mode, a bank guarantee valid for three years for the remaining project cost must be submitted
The project must be appraised by a bank where the entrepreneur holds an account
benefits_summary: One‑time capital subsidy of up to ₹30 lakh (50 % of project cost) for infrastructure, breeding animals, equipment, transportation and insurance.
